title: Tag
description: Small labels for marking and categorizing content; can be closable or clickable.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: color conveys meaning: neutral (default), primary, success, warning, danger and info.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: variant sets the visual style: subtle (default, tinted background), outline (adds a border) or solid (filled with the color). elevation adds a shadow to any variant.

sizes-shapes.title: Sizes and shapes
sizes-shapes.description: Three sizes and three shapes: square, rounded (default) and circle.

with-icon.title: With icon
with-icon.description: icon is displayed before the content.

closable.title: Closable
closable.description: Remove Tag 1, Tag 2 and Tag 3. After all tags are removed, Reset restores them.

clickable.title: Clickable (selectable)
clickable.description: clickable renders the content as a native button: focus it with Tab and activate it with a click, Enter or Space. Here the tags toggle a selection, exposed to assistive technologies with pressed.

avatar-loading.title: Avatar and loading
avatar-loading.description: avatar shows an avatar before the content. loading replaces the icon / avatar with a spinner, marks the tag busy, blocks its action and hides the close button.

custom-colors.title: Custom colors
custom-colors.description: The CSS custom properties --tag-<color>-bg and --tag-<color>-text override the colors of a color (inline, in a class or in a theme); ripple={false} disables the click ripple.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: Disabled tags ignore clicks, are removed from the tab order and disable their close button.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.clickable: With clickable, the tag gets role="button" and tabIndex=0, and Enter or Space trigger onClick just like a mouse click. Use it for actions or toggles, not for navigation (use a link instead).
accessibility.closable: The close button is a native <button> with its own tab stop. Its accessible name defaults to "Close"; set closeLabel (e.g. "Remove React") so screen-reader users know which tag it removes.
accessibility.disabled: A disabled clickable tag keeps role="button" with aria-disabled="true" and is skipped by Tab. When the selected state matters, also convey it in text or with aria attributes, not only with color.

TagProps.variant: Visual style: subtle (tinted background), outline (tinted background with a border) or solid (filled with the color, inverse text)
TagProps.onClose: Called when the close button is clicked
TagProps.clickable: Renders the tag content as a native button (focusable, activated with Enter / Space). With closable, the close button is a sibling button
TagProps.onClick: Called when the tag is activated (requires clickable)
TagProps.pressed: Pressed (selected) state of a toggle tag, e.g. a selectable filter (requires clickable); sets aria-pressed and the selected style
TagProps.avatar: Avatar (e.g. a small Avatar or image) displayed before the content
TagProps.loading: Shows a spinner instead of the icon / avatar, marks the tag busy and blocks its action; the close button is hidden
TagProps.disabled: Disables the tag and its close button
TagProps.closeLabel: Accessible label of the close button: a string, or a function of the tag's text label. Defaults to "Remove {label}" (localized), or "Close" when the tag has no text
TagProps.ripple: Shows a ripple effect on click

cssVars.--tag-height: Minimum height (every size; default: the content height)
cssVars.--tag-radius: Corner radius of the rounded shape (defaults to --radius-sm)
cssVars.--tag-gap: Space between the icon, the label and the close button
cssVars.--tag-ring-color: Color of the hairline ring of the tinted (default) variant (defaults to the text color at 16%)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: A small label; color sets its semantic tone.

variants-sizes.title: Variants, sizes and content
variants-sizes.description: Three variants, sizes and shapes, elevation, the icon and avatar slots, loading and disabled.

closable.title: Closable
closable.description: closable adds a close button that fires minerva-close: remove the tag in the listener and move focus to a neighbour. close-label and the close-icon slot customize it.

toggle.title: Toggle filters
toggle.description: clickable toggle tags are toggle buttons (aria-pressed): a click flips pressed and fires minerva-change. A plain clickable tag fires click.

props.toggle: Makes a clickable tag a toggle: clicks flip pressed and fire minerva-change.
props.noRipple: Disables the ripple effect of clickable tags.

events.minerva-change: A toggle tag was toggled (detail: { pressed }).

slots.avatar: Avatar (small <minerva-avatar> or image) before the label.

methods.focus: Focuses the tag's button (the action button of a clickable tag, else the close button).

closable.title: Closable
closable.description: Remove Tag 1, Tag 2 and Tag 3. After all tags are removed, Reset restores them.

colors-variants.title: Colors and variants
colors-variants.description: Colors and variants using Tag; the preview follows the selected site theme and palette.

selectable.title: Selectable tags
selectable.description: Selectable tags using Tag; the preview follows the selected site theme and palette.
